narrative.intro: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligated $2.2B in FY2026 to date. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies has 1 award this fiscal year, with an average award size of $2.2B, and obligations are up 4.2% year over year. Yearly obligations show multi-year scale and variability: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligated $1.7B in FY21, $2B in FY22, $1.8B in FY23, $1.8B in FY24, $2.1B in FY25, and $2.2B in FY26. The current-year total is partial, fiscal year to date. The dataset reports contract obligations except where tables list award values and expiring-contract totals as total contract values. Readers should note the current-year figure covers only part of FY2026, so full-year comparisons will change as the year completes. The single large award this year drives the average award size figure and shapes the year-over-year increase. Analysts tracking vendor scale or workload should treat FY2026 as an interim snapshot and compare the sequence of fiscal-year obligations to identify stability, step changes, or return to prior levels over the five-year sequence provided.
